concept_blueprint.agent_message: Here's the concept blueprint for your Landscaping CRM MVP.

api_endpoints.description: Create a job linked to a customer
Fetch weekly calendar view (jobs by day)

app_ui_requirements: Customer list with search and lightweight filtering
Job list view per customer with create/edit/delete actions
Weekly calendar view aggregating jobs by day
Two-user login UI with role-based access
CSV export for Customers and Jobs
concept_blueprint.concept_overview: A lightweight, two-user web CRM tailored for small landscaping businesses. It manages Customers (name, phone, address, notes) and Jobs (date, type, price, status) linked to customers, plus a weekly calendar view that aggregates Jobs by day. The MVP emphasizes fast onboarding, simple role separation (owner vs helper), and essential CRUD workflows without invoicing, external calendar integrations, or mobile-native features.
constraints: No external calendar integrations in MVP
Data resides in-app for the MVP
CSV export available as MVP capability
core_features: Customer CRUD with fields: name, phone, address, notes
Job CRUD linked to a Customer (date, type, price, status)
Weekly calendar view showing jobs by day
Two-user authentication with simple role separation
Search, filter, and basic status tracking for customers and jobs
CSV export of Customers and Jobs
core_jobs: Manage customer records (name, phone, address, notes)
Schedule and view jobs in a weekly calendar
Authenticate two users with basic role separation (owner vs helper)
Search and filter customers and jobs
Track basic job status (Planned, In Progress, Completed, Canceled)

monetization_intent.money_flow_summary: No revenue flow is required for the MVP; the initial scope is a free two-user MVP.
monetization_intent.rationale: The MVP targets a tiny team and does not include paid access, usage credits, or marketplace features.

surface_candidate_hints.label: Customer registry
surface_candidate_hints.rationale: Durable customer data module at the core of the CRM.

surface_candidate_hints.label: Weekly schedule calendar
surface_candidate_hints.rationale: Scheduling view that consumes job data and presents a calendar-centric workflow.

concept_blueprint.target_user: Owner of a small landscaping business seeking a fast, simple CRM with scheduling for a two-person team.
unique_differentiators: Landscaping-focused data model with ready-made service types and simple pricing constructs
Integrated weekly scheduling tightly coupled with customer records
Minimal onboarding friction for a two-user setup
Clear boundaries to avoid scope creep and keep maintenance lightweight
concept_blueprint.value_proposition: A focused, easy-to-setup CRM with an integrated weekly scheduling view that helps two-person landscaping teams coordinate customers and jobs quickly and with minimal friction.

provider_api_response_contract.description: A MozaiksPay-compatible provider serves the provider API endpoints consumed by generated apps. Response shapes are pinned in provider_api_contract.yaml. Any change to field names or types on either side is a breaking change requiring coordinated release.

subscriptions_yaml_price_block.description: Optional price metadata on each plan entry in app/config/subscriptions.yaml. When present on a plan, a compatible provider may use this metadata to map or provision provider-owned billing objects. When absent, the plan is free or requires provider/operator-side pricing configuration.
subscriptions_yaml_price_block.example:
plans:
  - plan_id: pro
    label: Pro
    price:
      amount: 29        # dollars
      currency: usd
      interval: month   # month | year
    billing:
      lookup_key: my_app_pro_monthly   # optional stable provider mapping key
      allow_promotion_codes: true
    capabilities: [...]

provider_lifecycle_boundary.description: The selected provider may read the app bundle's app/config/subscriptions.yaml catalog to map paid plans and top-up products to provider-owned billing objects. Mapping, provisioning, idempotency, provider IDs, payment processor objects, and hosted operational records remain provider-owned and are not generated into the canonical app bundle.

required_integrations.purpose: Connect this generated SaaS app to the managed MozaiksPay subscription provider.

runtime_boundaries.rule: Keep entitlement enforcement on the OSS runtime/module contract path.
Read runtime token usage through /api/me/usage or /api/admin/usage; use the OSS token wallet ledger for balances instead of app-local duplicate ledgers.

Use app/config/subscriptions.yaml usage_limits, token_wallets, token_allowances, depleted_balance, and top_up_products for generated SaaS plan limits, token allowances, and recovery paths only when the app sells AI usage, credits, quotas, or token packs; access-only plans omit token wallet fields.
Token top-up products are provider-neutral app contract entries; MozaiksPay only creates checkout sessions and must confirm payment before OSS billing fulfillment credits tokens.
Do not generate managed service internals, checkout, wallet, settlement logic, private APIs, or provider credentials.

Generated apps must configure MozaiksPay through the app-scoped connector named mozaikspay and its scoped vault secret. MOZAIKSPAY_* environment configuration is a setup fallback only when no connector record exists. Unreadable or incomplete saved connectors fail closed; never combine their provider endpoint with environment credentials. Never commit provider credentials.
Generated pages must call app-owned billing_portal actions, not managed backing modules directly.

surface_ownership.owner: MozaiksPay billing state (OSS runtime owns fulfilled entitlements and token wallets)

operator_contracts.description:
Machine-readable interface spec for the MozaiksPay provider API. Consumed by generated SaaS apps via mozaikspay_client.py. Served by the selected MozaiksPay-compatible provider. The hosted MozaiksPay service is the default provider implementation, but self-hosted or alternative providers may satisfy this same app-facing contract.
This file defines ONLY the public interface — request shape, response shape, auth scheme, and which fields are forbidden from responses. No payment provider logic, fee calculations, or subscription business rules belong here.

drift_guard.description: Changes to this file must be reflected in: - The selected provider server implementation - The generated client template (templates/services/integrations/mozaikspay_client.py) - The generated billing_portal schemas (templates/modules/billing_portal/backend/schemas.py) If any of these diverge, generated SaaS apps will break silently at runtime.

endpoints.description: Return whether the selected MozaiksPay-compatible provider is reachable and serving this public contract. This endpoint is a readiness check only; it must not create accounts, activate billing, mutate subscription state, transmit source code, or incur charges.
Return the current subscription plan for the calling app scope. Safe for display in generated app billing pages.
Create a hosted billing portal redirect session. The caller redirects their end-user to portal_url. No subscription state is mutated by this call.

Create a hosted subscription checkout redirect session for a paid plan. The caller redirects their end-user to checkout_url. No OSS runtime state is mutated by this call; subscription fulfillment is driven by the selected provider after the payment provider confirms the subscription.

Create a hosted token top-up checkout session for a provider-neutral top_up_products entry declared by the generated app. Payment confirmation must produce an OSS BillingFulfillmentCommand with event_type token_top_up_paid before tokens are credited.

application_errors.BILLING_CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND: Subscription exists but billing provider customer not yet linked.
application_errors.CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH: Provider and generated client do not agree on the MozaiksPay public contract version.
application_errors.CUSTOM_PLAN_REQUIRES_SALES: Plan requires operator setup before self-serve checkout.
application_errors.INVALID_INPUT: Required field missing or unsafe URL.
application_errors.MOZAIKSPAY_BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED: Selected MozaiksPay-compatible provider is not configured.
application_errors.MOZAIKSPAY_PRICE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Selected provider has no price mapping for the plan.
application_errors.PLAN_NOT_CHECKOUTABLE: Free/default plan cannot be purchased through checkout.
application_errors.SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_EXISTS: The requested billing scope already has an active paid subscription.
application_errors.SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND: No subscription record for the given scope.
application_errors.TOKEN_TOP_UP_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: The requested token top-up product is not declared by the app.

http_errors.400: Invalid request body (missing return_url, unsafe URL, etc.).
http_errors.401: Missing or invalid MozaiksPay API key or client credentials.
http_errors.403: MozaiksPay credential app or user/tenant/workspace scope does not allow this request.
http_errors.404: No subscription found for this scope (subscription_status only — not an HTTP 404).

subscription_contract.rationale: The LandscapingCRM MVP is a two-user, web-based CRM with no paid access, no quotas, and no token usage. Monetization intents indicate a free MVP for a two-user team; therefore no app-owned subscription or token contract is required at this time.
